card.name: Weight units and handling instructions
card.fires_on: Fires on a weight unit (Kg, kg) after a patient weight, and on set phrases in preparation instructions such as 'inspected' and 'regulations' in disposal wording.

modes.label: Weight units
modes.description: The unit kg after a number giving patient body weight.

modes.label: Disposal wording
modes.description: The word 'regulations' ending a phrase about disposing of unused product.
modes.example: in compliance with applicable<< regulations>>. 2.3 Use with Som

modes.label: Visual inspection phrase
modes.description: The word 'inspected' in the standard line about checking parenteral products for particles.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be<< inspected>> visually for particulate matter and discolor
